comparisons.peer_summary: Citi progressed on divestitures including exits from Korea, Poland, and Russia, and completed the separation of its Mexico Services, Markets, Banking and Wealth businesses from its consumer banking operations in December 2024, a milestone for a planned IPO.
comparisons.comparison: Both Bank of America and Citi are actively optimizing their physical and geographic footprint within their consumer banking franchises, though through different mechanisms. Bank of America is executing a gradual operational reduction of its domestic network, citing a net decrease of 145 financial centers and 275 ATMs to optimize capacity. In contrast, Citi is pursuing a more radical strategic refresh by exiting entire international markets and divesting major regional operations, such as completing the separation of its Mexico consumer business and exiting operations in Korea, Poland, and Russia. While both are reducing physical presence, BAC focuses on domestic branch/ATM density optimization, whereas Citi focuses on complete geographic market exits and structural separations.

sentences.text: We had a net decrease of 145 financial centers and 275 ATMs as we continued to optimize our consumer banking network.

• As part of its strategic refresh, Citi continued to make progress on its remaining divestitures, including exits of its consumer banking operations in Korea and Poland and its overall operations in Russia. Additionally, Citi completed the separation of its Services, Markets, Banking and Wealth businesses in Mexico from its consumer banking and small business and middle-market banking operations in Mexico (Mexico Consumer/SBMM) in December 2024, an important milestone toward the planned initial public offering (IPO) of Citi's Mexico Consumer/SBMM business.
